enginePower.name: Engine power
enginePower.description: Torque and power at the rear wheel. More makes wheelies and loop-outs easier.

tyreGrip.name: Tyre grip
tyreGrip.description: How hard the knobbies bite the dirt before they spin or slide.

frontSpring.name: Fork spring rate
frontSpring.description: Stiffness of the front fork in newtons per metre. Softer soaks bumps but bottoms out on big landings.

rearSpring.name: Shock spring rate
rearSpring.description: Stiffness of the rear shock at the axle. Softer squats more under throttle.

suspensionDamping.name: Suspension damping
suspensionDamping.description: How much the fork and shock resist moving. Low feels pogo-like, high feels harsh.

brakeStrength.name: Brake strength
brakeStrength.description: Clamping force of both brakes. Strong front braking can pitch the rider over the bars.

gripStrength.name: Rider grip
gripStrength.description: How much force the hands and boots take before they tear free of the bars and pegs.

muscleStrength.name: Rider strength
muscleStrength.description: Torque the rider's joints can make to hold a position and absorb landings.

leanReach.name: Lean range
leanReach.description: How far the rider moves the hips forward and back when leaning.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.description: Downward acceleration in metres per second squared. Earth is 9.81.

viewWidth.name: View width
viewWidth.description: How many metres of trail fit across the screen while riding.

lookAhead.name: Look-ahead
lookAhead.description: How far the camera leads the bike in the direction it is moving.

sunWarmth.name: Golden light
sunWarmth.description: Strength of the warm low-sun grade, flare and light shafts.

dustAmount.name: Dust and roost
dustAmount.description: How much dust and dirt the tyres and crashes throw up.

showPhysics.name: Show physics
showPhysics.description: Overlay collision shapes, joints and the load on each grip.

masterVolume.name: Volume
masterVolume.description: Overall loudness of engine, impacts and forest.
